rotation.note: Unattended run: FULL music keyword set used (core + every entry in sections.music.keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date-based rotation (day-of-month 18) is still applied to EMPHASIS: which creator channels the YouTube sweep targets (18 mod 6 = 0 -> Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs lead, Benn Jordan carried as the third-party voice) and which keyword clusters lead the query order (tooling/plugin cluster leads today because the last two days of news_data.json were heavy on licensing/litigation).

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen pages for these outlets; the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate is inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then use WebSearch queries to fill gaps.
retrieval_hint.youtube_feed_pattern: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<UC...> — resolve channel_id by fetching https://www.youtube.com/@<handle> and reading `channelId` / `og:url` from the HTML. Verify uploadDate from the watch-page JSON-LD before accepting.
retrieval_hint.note: Music trade outlets (musicradar, musictech, gearnews, bedroomproducersblog, synthtopia, cdm.link) publish many items per day; the feed pass alone should carry most of this section.
